lines.text: Stop. Before you sell your grandma's records for a dollar, look at this tiny ring.
Most people sell old vinyl by the box.
But zoom in. Each side is one groove, a spiral a third of a mile long.
The needle rides its tiny wiggles, and those wiggles are the music.
Past the last song is a smooth band. Collectors call it the dead wax.
Those scratched letters were etched in when the record was cut.
They help collectors tell which pressing it is, and early pressings can sell for far more.
So scan the crate first. This one: an estimated eighty to two hundred dollars.
I used Scan For Worth. Check the crate before the yard sale.
